Bassist Earl May was born in New York City on September 17, 1927. He spent eight productive years in the 50s with the Billy Taylor Trio and was the bassist on John Coltrane’s album “Lush Life.” Earl’s ability to play a wide variety of styles has enabled him to share the stage and studio with a lengthy list of jazz luminaries.
Earl was interviewed in New York City on January 11, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
